/usr/bin/bash -lc "/opt/conda/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import csv

# load verified unique
files=sorted(Path('run_trace/extracted').glob('*_psm_rank.txt'))
verified=set()
for f in files:
    lines=f.read_text().splitlines()
    h=lines[0].split('\\t'); ci=h.index('confident'); pi=h.index('peptide')
    for line in lines[1:]:
        p=line.split('\\t')
        if p[ci]=='Yes': verified.add(p[pi])
print('verified', len(verified))

# parse SGPS
sgps={}
path=Path('data/inputs/sgps_peptide_report/SGPS_peptide-report.tabular')
with path.open() as fh:
    for i,line in enumerate(fh):
        if i==0:
            continue
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        # columns: empty c1, protein c2, ... sequence c6
        if len(parts) < 6: continue
        seq=parts[5].strip()
        prot=parts[1].strip()
        sgps.setdefault(seq,set())
        for pid in prot.split(';'):
            pid=pid.strip()
            if pid: sgps[seq].add(pid)
print('sgps peptides', len(sgps), 'sgps mapping verified', sum(1 for s in verified if s in sgps))

# parse MaxQuant
mq={}
path=Path('data/inputs/maxquant_peptide_report/MaxQuant-peptide-report.tabular')
with path.open() as fh:
    header=None
    for i,line in enumerate(fh):
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if i==0:
            header=parts
            continue
        if header:
            seq=parts[0].strip()
            prot=parts[34].strip() if len(parts)>34 else ''  # 0-index 34 => c35
        else:
            seq=parts[0].strip(); prot=parts[34].strip() if len(parts)>34 else ''
        mq.setdefault(seq,set())
        for pid in prot.split(';'):
            pid=pid.strip()
            if pid: mq[seq].add(pid)
print('mq peptides', len(mq), 'mq mapping verified', sum(1 for s in verified if s in mq))

# combined mapping
missing=[]; pairs=[]
for s in sorted(verified):
    ids=set()
    ids |= sgps.get(s,set())
    ids |= mq.get(s,set())
    if not ids:
        missing.append(s); continue
    for pid in sorted(ids):
        pairs.append((s,pid))
print('missing', len(missing), missing)
print('pairs', len(pairs), 'unique pairs', len(set(pairs)))
# duplicate peptide pairs? 
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter(pairs)
print('dup count', sum(1 for v in cnt.values() if v>1), max(cnt.values(), default=0))
print('sample pairs', pairs[:10])
PY"
